name: caretech-games-pwa-deployment
description: Paquete de despliegue y producción para el portal CareTech Games y juegos PWA (Solitario Care)

scripts.deploy: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('cd dist && cp games/index.html index.html && cp -rf games/publicidad publicidad && cp -rf games/donar donar && rm -f ../caretech-games.zip && zip -r ../caretech-games.zip index.html games publicidad donar && cp ../caretech-games.zip ../../caretech-games.zip'); console.log('✅ caretech-games.zip generado');" && node scripts/deploy-hostinger.js
scripts.build:zip: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('cd dist && cp games/index.html index.html && cp -rf games/publicidad publicidad && cp -rf games/donar donar && rm -f ../caretech-games.zip && zip -r ../caretech-games.zip index.html games publicidad donar && cp ../caretech-games.zip ../../caretech-games.zip'); console.log('✅ caretech-games.zip generado con éxito');"

author: CareTech Services
